decision_rule: Pass only when the image is recognizable at browse-card scale, materially distinguishes the entry from its common confusions, and preserves any qualified semantic boundary from source verification.
verification_boundary: A structural-review pass advances the staged reference image to reviewed. It does not publish the pattern; runtime integration, static routes, SEO, commerce wiring, and browser QA remain separate gates.
review_history: The first generated contact sheet was not accepted wholesale. Buffalo Check, Shepherd's Check, Gun Club Check, and Diamond Pattern were regenerated after visual review found insufficient differentiation or edge/tessellation problems. The refined 20-image set was then reviewed again.
